Spec: Overview shows work in progress — UI atlas

Spec: Overview shows work in progress — UI atlas

3 views with 12 states. Mocked: Placement options. The remaining areas are listed from the map and are not designed yet.

Illustrative only. Low-fi wireframes on the app’s tokens: they decide anatomy, states and copy intent, not the final look. All names and data are fictional. Card text is rendered from the cards files and the view list from spec-overview-in-progress-ui-map.md: change the markdown and regenerate. Link to a view or a state by id: #A1, #A1-s2.

Compared with today’s app

Paseo FSH fork fsh at b245e51ae (2026-11-24), Overview as approved in spec-overview-tree.

Where in-progress work shows today, none of it on Overview:

  • Sidebar row: a spinning ring while the workspace counts as running (an agent turn, subagents, monitors, background shells). No count, no names.
  • Agent tabs strip: a ring on an agent's icon while its turn runs.
  • Composer bar of one agent: subagents pill ("3 working", "1 failed", "2 ready to review"), status pill ("working · 8h", "· stale" after 2 turns), Asks pill (open asks only, hidden at 0).
  • Explorer tabs: Status (cards, "N turns since"), Asks ("Needs you" and "In progress" sections), Lineage (agents with a ring while running).
  • Overview: Status shows the card's word ("Working") with no age; Your move shows only what waits on you, plus "Archive waits for background work" once the work shipped; Tree shows child workspaces' state words and "· N agents" on this workspace's row. A running agent, subagents, background shells and in-progress asks appear nowhere.

3 new views. Inside frames, while Changes is on: new changed removed (removed parts show only then).

Decisions (stage 1, 2026-11-25)

  1. In progress lists all four kinds: agents with a running turn, their subagents, background work an idle agent left running, and asks in progress (A5).
  2. Grouped: one row per agent and per ask; each agent's subagents and background work fold under it as counted lines (A6).

Placement options — area rules

source: spec-overview-in-progress-ui-placement.md

Area-wide

  • Purpose. Compare three placements of in-progress work for A4. Every option is drawn on the same three workspaces, in the same order, so frames with the same state id compare directly.
  • Workspaces. Busy: the agent's turn runs, it has 6 subagents (2 working), a background shell, 3 asks in progress and 1 ask waiting on you. Stuck: the turn ended 8 hours ago, the status card still says Working, nothing runs, 5 asks are in progress (3 wait on CI, 2 have nothing moving them). Nothing in progress: one ask waits on you, nothing else moves.
  • Device. Desktop: Overview tab in the Explorer sidebar, ~420 px wide. Mobile: the workspace sheet, 390 px. Same content, same order.
  • Rows. As in the approved Overview: one line per row, a name, a muted facts word, a chevron when it opens something. Tones as the app's state words: running accent, waiting warning, blocked/failed danger, done success, idle muted.
  • Buttons. Only Your move has buttons, in every option.
  • Permissions. None beyond opening the workspace.

V1 Own section

newP14 states · Explorer panel · 420 (mobile sheet · 390)card text: spec-overview-in-progress-ui-placement.md

Short

In-progress work gets its own section, "In progress", directly after Your move.

Change

New.

Extended

One row per agent with a running turn and one per ask in progress. Each agent's subagents and background work fold under it as indented lines with counts. Ask rows say what they wait on and how long; an ask with nothing moving it is flagged in the warning tone. The section is hidden when nothing is in progress. Your move stays above it, so what you must do still comes first.

Get here

Overview tab.

Shows

Section label "In progress" with a count; agent rows ("Track lead · working · 3m"), indented "6 subagents · 2 working" and "merge-queue.sh · running 2h" lines, ask rows ("PR #1379 · CI running · 20m").

Variants

Busy; stuck; nothing in progress (section absent); mobile sheet of stuck.

Edge cases

A long list (more than five asks) shows five, then "Show all (8)". An agent whose turn ends while you look drops out of the section in place.

V2 Inside Status

newP14 states · Explorer panel · 420 (mobile sheet · 390)card text: spec-overview-in-progress-ui-placement.md

Short

In-progress work is one summary line inside the Status section, under the card's summary.

Change

New.

Extended

The Status section gains a "Moving now" line with counts per kind: "Agent working · 6 subagents · 1 shell · 3 asks". Pressing a count opens where those items already live: the agent tab, its subagents popover, the Asks tab. No rows, so nothing says what an ask waits on; a stuck ask shows only as "2 not moving" in the warning tone. The line is absent when nothing moves.

Get here

Overview tab, Status section.

Shows

Status pill and summary as today, then the "Moving now" line of counts.

Variants

Busy; stuck; nothing in progress (line absent); mobile sheet of stuck.

Edge cases

With no status card the line shows under the state word taken from the agents.

V3 Under Your move

newP14 states · Explorer panel · 420 (mobile sheet · 390)card text: spec-overview-in-progress-ui-placement.md

Short

In-progress asks join Your move as muted rows after yours, under an "Agent's move" divider.

Change

New.

Extended

Only asks: agents, subagents and background work stay where they are today (tab rings, composer pills). The muted rows have no buttons and expand read-only. Your move's heading shows whenever either group has rows, so a workspace with only in-progress asks shows "Your move" with nothing for you in it.

Get here

Overview tab, Your move section.

Shows

Your rows with buttons; divider "Agent's move · 3"; muted ask rows ("PR #1379 · CI running").

Variants

Busy; stuck; nothing in progress (divider absent); mobile sheet of stuck.

Edge cases

An ask moving from in progress to open moves above the divider and gains its buttons.
